extension.description: Go interface implementation navigation within a module (in development).
configuration.hideTestingImplementations: Hide relations with a type declaration or required direct method reported only in _test.go files importing testing. An eligible source for the same method prevents filtering on that method. Unresolved and promoted method sources are retained and marked; language-service coverage remains limited.
configuration.codeLens: Automatically show clickable related interface or concrete type names above visible type declarations.
configuration.gutterIcons: Show implementation direction icons beside type declarations with reported matches. Hover for navigation links.
